about_the_game:
Based on the actual scientific phenomena of impacta ejecta comes a tale based entirely in imagination. What if the dinosaurs that were yeeted out into space..... survived? What if they made it to The Moon(tm)?

This game asks and answers these important questions.

The Theropod Empire devours all. Good thing "all" for right now is the dark side of the moon. There's still time to fight.

Legendary Smuggler Hornstar cares not for rebellions. Princess Zauren lives for them.

As Hornstar, you must do the dirty work. As Zauren, you must navigate political minefields. Together, they must set aside their differences to unite the Moon Colonies and fight for Moon Freedom. 

This is science fiction. This is tragedy.

This is dino-powered post-apocalyptic theater.

  • Genre: Visual Novel

  • Wacky sci-fi satire: step into the shoes of multiple dinosaur heroes in a game filled with choice-driven storytelling

  • Five+ story variables to manipulate for incredible branching outcomes that may or may not vary in incredibility

  • Five+ endings (synergy with the above featured bullet point! Cool!)

  • Reactive narrative: Declare mortal enemies. Form lunar alliances. Accidentally explode the wrong moon base

  • Maybe get some dinosaurs to kiss

name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
short_description: The Saurian Alliance is threatened by The Theropod Empire. That's scary. Our heroes, a ragtag group of dinosaurs from all walks of life (and one that is definitely not a Corgi-Iguanodon hybrid), must band together to fight back against the dark side of The Moon(tm).
